## TOOL · get_customer_context (Lesson 5.7)
Called by the Sage Desk agent before every reply. customer_id is fixed by the workflow, not chosen by the AI, so the agent can only read the customer it is answering.
Returns the timeline across channels (last 30 messages), open orders and the decisions table.

Credentials: Postgres (Supabase).
Adjust the open orders query to your orders table (it joins on a verified phone).

parameters.query:
select m.at, m.channel, m.direction, m.sent_by, left(m.text, 400) as text
from messages m join conversations c on c.id = m.conversation_id
where c.customer_id = $1
order by m.at desc limit 30;
select type, value, decided_by, at from decisions where customer_id = $1 order by at desc;
